Page 1350 
Otarmeni (lunsotogene parvec-cwha) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-707201  
Guideline Name 
Otarmeni (lunsotogene parvec-cwha)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Otarmeni  
Diagnosis 
Sensorineural hearing loss  
Approval Length 
3 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming diagnosis of severe-to-
profound or profound sensorineural hearing loss defined as any frequency greater than 90 
decibel hearing level (dB HL)  


--- PDF page 1351 ---
Page 1351 
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming both of the following:  
• 
Preserved outer hair cell function  
• 
No prior cochlear implant in the same ear  
 
AND 
 
3 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes, laboratory values) confirming presence 
of biallelic variants in the OTOF gene  
 
AND 
 
4 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following with shared-decision-making 
regarding treatment risks:  
• 
Otolaryngologist  
• 
Otologist/neurotologist  
 
AND 
 
5 - Will be administered at an authorized treatment center by a surgeon experienced in 
intracochlear surgery and trained in administration  
 
AND 
 
6 - Provider attests that patient has never received Otarmeni treatment in the target ear in 
their lifetime  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
8/26/2026  
New program
